material_difference: Old Plane468 was screened without a saved design or API call. primary_math.derivation: The complete radius-2 cluster is dilated by one hex-neighbor layer. It adds 18 distinct white tiles, not 30 exposed edge contacts: six new corner tiles touch one old edge and twelve new side tiles touch two. White=6+18=24, black=13, difference=11.
